name: biology-basics golden set
description: Synthetic 12-question golden set for the biology-basics mini book. Demonstrates every question kind of the tl:eval golden-set schema. The 'teacher' role labels this set as the reference (held-out) question set for the role comparison table; in a real corpus the role should reflect the question provenance.

questions.query: chlorophyll inside the chloroplasts absorbs sunlight
questions.note: keyword-style: every term occurs in the target chunk, so BM25 AND-matches

questions.query: how green plants convert light into chemical energy during photosynthesis
questions.note: paraphrase: 'how' keeps BM25's AND-match from firing, dense cosine must carry it

questions.query: the calvin cycle happens in the stroma and uses atp and nadph
farmers add greenhouse lighting in winter so their crops keep producing sugars
mitosis produces two identical daughter cells
questions.note: section-title expectation: resolves to every chunk of the section

questions.query: crossing over during meiosis shuffles genes and creates genetic variation
الجينات تنتقل عبر الكروموسومات إلى الأبناء
الجينات وحدات الوراثة التي تنتقل من الآباء إلى الأبناء
questions.note: page-range expectation: synthetic chunk pages are chunkIndex+1, so page 5 is chunk c4

questions.query: الصفات المتنحية تحتاج إلى نسختين من الجين
ما هي عملية البناء الضوئي في النبات
questions.note: Arabic question about content that exists ONLY in the ENGLISH chunk: needs a multilingual encoder (bge-m3); the hash standin honestly fails it

questions.query: why do children inherit eye color from their parents
questions.note: English question about content that exists ONLY in the ARABIC chunk

questions.query: explain more about the calvin cycle in the stroma
questions.note: anaphoric: the harness feeds the parent query through the production heuristic rewriter; the dense leg scores the RAW query exactly like production does
off-topic probe (eval.py style: deliberately unrelated, zero lexical overlap with the book): MUST be refused by the gate
Arabic off-topic probe: MUST be refused by the gate
